meta.title: cat-loop
meta.description: One cat-loop conversation whose three sub-conversations are the Plan, Build and Review teams. Opening the conversation lands in the Plan sub-conversation; each team has an enforced permission boundary.

roles.plan: Leads the Plan team — splits work into task briefs under .cat-prompt and dispatches them.
roles.build: Leads the Build team — implements each brief, runs its own checks, and hands code to Review.
roles.review: Leads the Review team — writes and runs check code under .cat-test and reports verdicts to Plan.
